name: Teen Council
org: Berkeley Repertory Theatre, School of Theatre
what_you_do: 10 to 15 Bay Area high schoolers plan Teen Night programs, host original works showcases, organize advocacy events and interview artists.
who_can_apply: Bay Area high school students. A new group starts at the beginning of each school year.
pay_detail: Transportation stipend. Free admission to teen programs and shows, and free food at events.
deadline_text: A new group is chosen at the start of each school year. No 2026 to 2027 dates are posted; join the mailing list for news.
how_to_apply: Join the Teen Council mailing list on the Teen Council page, or email teencouncil@berkeleyrep.org.
notes: No grade or age rule is listed beyond high school. Competitive: only 10 to 15 spots.
